_doc: Thủy Vân's Still Water greybox (plan phase 1, T5): today's world squares (data/world/squares.json: the same grid, types and river block, so today's baked ground and the river bed it cut still match) with two additions, the river's `reaches` and the `region` block. WorldRegion.set_region('r1_grey') makes WorldSquares read this file instead of today's. The ground stays today's baked valley (no terrain_dir); R1's own ground is Phase 3's.

size_m: a square's side. grid: rows along world -Z to +Z, columns along -X to +X; the middle one (square 0,0) is the old fort's clearing, grown over in the greybox (FrontierTerrain.open_ground). The compass's north lies 44 deg off the axes (WorldClock.north_offset_deg).
types: as today's (the greybox has no wildlife spawner; the fish read their square's water).

region._doc: The region (WorldRegion.info; ThuyVanLevel sets the clock from it). latitude_deg: about 21 N, the foothills below Đá Trắng. season and day_of_year: the early rains (mid-May, the survival calendar's may_mid: game day 13, day 135). start_hour: the morning the greybox opens on. title_status: the English title is a placeholder until the owner names the place (plan 9, Q3).
region.name: Đá Trắng
region.title: the White Stone Reach

river._doc: The river (bake_terrain.py cuts its bed; WorldRiver and RiverWater put its water): today's numbers exactly (its bed is baked in today's ground). reaches: the still reach (WorldRiver.reaches): between z_from and z_to its flow is scaled by the world's state (scale_by_state; WorldRiver.reach_state, the level's S0 / S1 on F9), full inside ease_m of its ends and eased to nothing at them, so outside the reach nothing changes. Placed between the first two rapids (-250 and 60), clear of both.
river._rapids: White water: [z of its middle, length, drop]; the fords. As today's.
